metadata.description: leunsoo — a frontend developer who builds polished, thoughtful web experiences.

hero.headline: Code is a compulsion
hero.tagline: Reaching for the best, still finding my best.
hero.body1: I don't define myself by a job title. What I enjoy is the building itself — the constant thinking, the problem-solving that never quite ends.
hero.body2: Frontend is where my strengths are right now, and I get the most out of it when I'm creating visual delight for users and shaping the components behind it.
